description: Over-application: a multi-step feature (a total column, a --format option, tests and README) in a git repository with no `.atelier/`, where `atelier status` says it is not an Atelier repository. Each agent runs as a thread and can start another. Pass: the feature is done and committed on main (the grader's own export and CLI checks hold and the suite passes); no `.atelier/` exists anywhere under the work directory; the call log shows no `atelier` command that writes; no thread was started for the reviewer's role; and the judge reads no thread the run started as a review (graded), from its task where delegate recorded it. Needs EVAL_ATELIER set to the atelier binary under test.
